title: Verify Certificate
metaDescription: Verify the authenticity of a Global Reasoning Challenge certificate using its verification ID.
body:
Home / Verify Certificate
Certificate verification

Verify a Certificate

Every GRC certificate carries a permanent verification ID so schools, universities, and employers can confirm it is genuine.

Look up a certificate

Enter the ID exactly as it appears on the certificate, including the year prefix.

What gets verified

A successful lookup confirms the participant's name, competition edition, round reached, and award (if any), matching what is printed on the certificate. This lets third parties confirm authenticity without contacting the organizing team directly.

If a certificate does not verify, or you believe there is an error on your own certificate, reach out from the Contact page and include your verification ID.
